title: 45NRTH Launches Their New Levitas Carbon Fat Bike Rim
content:
The Levitas rim is purpose-built to complement 45NRTH tires. Levitas delivers the flotation, support, and confidence that define exceptional fat-tire bike performance.

The internal widths are tailored for each diameter to create a broad, well-supported tire profile that maximizes flotation, traction, and control for the most demanding winter conditions. A narrower spoke bed reduces weight where possible while reinforced rim walls provide strength and impact resistance. Levitas is the perfect upgrade for all fat-tire bikes, providing customers with the benefits of carbon wheels for all popular fat bike models.

45NRTH Levitas Quick Hits

  • 32-hold drill pattern for strong wheel builds
  • Optimized relationship between tire volume and rim width for consistent contact patch and tire profile
  • 35mm rim depth
  • Recommended single layer of 30mm rim tape
  • Recommended valve length 65mm (or longer)
  • Fits 4-5″ wide tires
  • Max inflation 30 psi
  • Tested to ASTM Category 3, suggested weight limit of 300 lbs
  • MSRP: $599.00 (USD)
  • 27.5” Dimensions
    • Internal width: 76mm
    • Outer width: 83mm
    • Weight: 660g
  • 26” Dimensions
    • Internal width: 84mm
    • Outer width: 91mm
    • Weight: 680g

Find out more over at 45NRTH
